newsitem.title: USA: Carver Bancorp sees $1.2 mln charge in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Carver Bancorp sees $1.2 mln charge in Q4.

text.p: Carver Bancorp Inc said Friday that as a result of acquiring $72 million of performing one-to-four-family mortgage loans, funded by the sale of money-market securities, it expects to incur a one-time pretax charge of $1.2 million in its fourth quarter, ending March 31.
The company also said that the transaction would result in an addition to its provision for loan losses of $1.6 million, neccessary to maintain an adequate allowance for such losses.
Carver said that it has been in a restructuring mode for the past two years and that this reallocation of assets from securites to loans is central to its new direction.

The company added that the yield on the mortgages would exceed that of the money market instruments, and expects a definitive agreement on the purchase of the loans in March, with the sale expected to close by March 31.
